name: Elks Club Corvallis

nadir.desc: The property consists of a commercial building with multiple connected flat-roof sections on a street-corner lot|A paved parking lot wraps the front and sides of the building|Street trees line both frontages|Sidewalks and a marked crosswalk sit at the intersection|Neighboring commercial buildings occupy adjacent lots|A residential neighborhood sits across the side streets.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces the intersection with a paved parking lot, street trees, and sidewalks|The structure has a light-colored flat roof with rooftop equipment|A sign is visible at the corner|Two public streets meet at the lot|Neighboring buildings sit behind and beside the site.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows additional flat-roof sections and a paved parking lot along the side street|Street trees and a sidewalk run along the frontage|A fence or wall is visible along the rear property edge|Neighboring structures sit immediately behind the lot.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows connected flat-roof sections, rooftop equipment, and a narrow paved area along the back wall|A fence or wall runs along the rear property line|Neighboring buildings sit close behind the site|The front parking lot and street trees remain visible on the opposite side.

delta.desc: The right side of the building faces a public street with a paved parking lot, large street trees, and a marked intersection|The main flat-roof mass and a mural or graphic on the side wall are visible|Neighboring parking and buildings sit at the far end of the lot.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from two public streets into a paved parking lot that wraps the building. The site is a corner commercial building with sidewalks, street trees, and a marked crosswalk. Circulation space is open in the lot. The rear is tighter, with neighboring buildings and a fence or wall along the back edge. A residential neighborhood sits nearby. City of Corvallis Public Works and other commercial sites occupy the wider corridor.
